AnchorView.description:
One part of a text exactly (API-02 /anchors/{id}, DAT-06): its span, locator, hashes, offset unit,
citation and attribution, and the words of the span themselves.
AnchorView.title: AnchorView

AuthorityEvidence.description:
Where an edition's authority or a language rule is stated: a page and the words of the document
(``document``), the address of another instrument (``external``), or the reviewer who recorded it.
AuthorityEvidence.title: AuthorityEvidence

JurisdictionDetail.description: One jurisdiction on a date (API /jurisdictions/{id}): a country's bodies, or a body's members.
JurisdictionDetail.title: JurisdictionDetail

LinkedAct.description:
A public record a checked link names (EDT-01), such as a national act that domesticates a treaty or
transposes a directive.
LinkedAct.title: LinkedAct

MembershipList.description:
Memberships in one direction on one date: the bodies a jurisdiction belongs to, or a body's members.
``items`` held on the date; ``ended`` had ended by then. ``unknown`` when no membership in this
direction is reviewed: never an empty list read as "none".
MembershipList.title: MembershipList

MembershipView.description:
One reviewed membership of the African Union or a regional body (JUR-04): the member, the body, the
first and last day it held (inclusive; no last day means it has not ended), the evidence and who
reviewed it when. Membership alone never applies the body's treaties to the member.
MembershipView.title: MembershipView

ProvisionLookup.description:
What a citation's pinpoint names in the works it resolves to: one part, alternatives (never a
guess) or none, with the reason, and when none, the nearest enclosing part that exists.
ProvisionLookup.title: ProvisionLookup

ProvisionMatch.description:
One part of a public text that a pinpoint names (API-04 provision lookup): its anchor, locator and
exact span. /anchors/{anchor_id} gives its words.
ProvisionMatch.title: ProvisionMatch

RegionalView.description: A regional instrument's legal effect, as its reviewed record states it (JUR-04, DAT-03).
RegionalView.title: RegionalView

RightsHistory.description: Every revision of a record's rights record, newest first, never edited (OA-R1).
RightsHistory.title: RightsHistory

SearchCoverage.description: What a text search covered: only published texts are searched, never a record's metadata alone.
SearchCoverage.title: SearchCoverage

scope.const: Catalogue metadata and cleared full text only
scope.default: Catalogue metadata and cleared full text only
scope.title: Scope

StatedDateView.description:
A reviewed date as its record gives it: the date, how precise it is, and as printed when the record
keeps that. A date with no normalised value is never compared with another.
StatedDateView.title: StatedDateView

StructurePage.description: A page of one text version's structure in document order (API-02 /versions/{id}/structure).
StructurePage.title: StructurePage

TextHit.description:
One passage of a published text that matches a search (OA-S1, RET-03): the part it is in, a
snippet of exact canonical bytes with its terms marked, and what quoting it asks for.
TextHit.title: TextHit

TextSearchPage.description:
A page of a search over published texts' provisions (OA-S1). ``status`` tells no result apart from
a scope with no published text and from a search that could not run.
TextSearchPage.title: TextSearchPage

TreatyPartyView.description:
One party to a treaty as its reviewed record lists it, with the acts of that state that a checked
link records as domesticating the treaty. Signature alone never binds (COR-01).
TreatyPartyView.title: TreatyPartyView

TreatyView.description:
A treaty's status, as its reviewed record states it (JUR-04, DAT-03). ``parties`` is on the record
and its anchors, never on an evidence unit; an empty list means none is recorded, never none exists.
TreatyView.title: TreatyView

VersionSelection.description:
Which text a date and a language select (API-02, OA-T3): one, alternatives with the reason, or
none. Never an arbitrary preference: a text with no effective date is never taken to be in force.
VersionSelection.title: VersionSelection
